title: Entrance Fee Agreement Disclosure Summary: Rescission and Pre-Occupancy Refund Terms
content:
Summary from the continuing care disclosure for the **Entrance Fee Agreement**: the rescission period of each Life Plan campus and the refund terms that apply when an agreement ends before occupancy.

## Rescission period by campus (all six refund plans)

| Campus | Rescission period after signing (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Larkspur at Willow Creek | 7 |
| Larkspur at Harbor View | 7 |
| Larkspur at Brookfield | 30 |

Each period is set at least as long as the continuing care statute of the campus state requires.

## Refund terms before occupancy

| Term | LifeChoice Declining Balance, 50%, 75% and 90% Refundable Plans | LifeCare Declining Balance and 90% Refundable Plans |
|---|---|---|
| Share of all money paid refunded on rescission | 100 percent | 100 percent |
| Rescission refund paid within | 30 calendar days after rescission | 30 calendar days after rescission |
| Pre-occupancy cancellation processing fee percentage | 2 percent of the entrance fee | 2 percent of the entrance fee |
| Share of money paid refunded when death, illness or injury prevents occupancy | 100 percent | 100 percent |
| Pre-occupancy refund paid within | 60 calendar days after the cancellation | 60 calendar days after the cancellation |

## Reading the summary

- The rescission period depends on the campus, not on the refund plan: Willow Creek and Harbor View allow 7 calendar days, Brookfield 30.
- Every figure in the second table is identical across the six plans.
